## Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) offer developers unprecedented programmatic
capabilities. This workshop introduces `ellmer` (R) and `chatlas` (Python),
Posit packages that simplify LLM API integration, handling conversation
complexities and enabling seamless interactions with AI models.

Participants will explore system prompt design, token management, and tool
calling while building familiarity with current AI technologies. The workshop
covers LLM integration, Shiny web app development, and touches on advanced
topics like dynamic information retrieval, context engineering, and agentic
workflows. Attendees will gain hands-on experience through guided exercises,
with the choice to work in R or Python.
